reviewer: independent read-only agent, no write access
fixed_after_review: BLOCKER failure.py: lot.finalize_fail now re-enqueues itself while net paid is not zero, so LS-10 can run without a manual second call.
MAJOR funding.py: try_fund returns early unless the lot is CHECKOUT_OPEN or FUNDING (a late capture no longer raises an illegal transition).
MAJOR router/deps: POST /merchant/profile no longer requires the merchant row it creates; the role check stays.
MAJOR auction_rules.py: R9 restored to contract section 11 (bid capacity only); seat coverage moved to R4 at bid submission.
PT-06 generator and assertions updated to generate contract-valid bids and use seat accounting.

MAJOR bids.py: every bid status write is a bid whitelist edge with its audit row (BS-12 on a revise, BS-02/03/05 on confirm). A save past bid_close_at answers 409 BID_WINDOW_CLOSED, so a late revision can no longer overwrite a CONFIRMED bid; a decided bid answers 409 LOT_NOT_BIDDING instead of a 500. Named tests: test_bid_sealing.py plus the new route-level test_merchant_bid_routes.py.

Named tests: test_an_in_flight_authorization_keeps_the_lot_failing, test_a_failing_lot_expires_buyers_part_way_through_paypal.

MINOR failure.py: the refund sequence comes from the stored paypal_refunds rows, so refund:{capture}:{seq} never reuses a key for a different payload (I9); _latest_refund orders by seq, not by a created_at that can tie.
MINOR authorize.py: the create call sends attempt as stored (N9 starts at 0) instead of max(1, attempt), so attempts 0 and 1 no longer share one PayPal-Request-Id.
MINOR merchant.py: GET /merchant/bids/{id} returns reject_reason, proven by test_a_rejected_bid_reports_its_reason_to_its_owner.
MINOR profile.py: an attestation is stored only from a real boolean; "false" is a VALIDATION_ERROR, never an acceptance.
MINOR demo_seed.py: no default password in source; it comes from --password or DEMO_SEED_PASSWORD and is never printed. .env.example documents the key.
